Subject: a compact stack of three faceted arcade scoring chips, with one bright star-shaped score spark above them. Clear strong silhouette, simple shapes, no lettering or numerals.

Constraints: single icon only; original artwork; no words, numbers, labels, signatures, logos, brands, stock watermarks or extra decoration. Keep all glow inside the transparent canvas.

icons.revisionPrompt: Edit this single transparent neon game upgrade icon. Preserve its exact open-doorway composition, two steps, cyan/violet/lime palette, clean silhouette and transparent outer background. Repair only the central upward arrow: make the entire arrow shaft and triangular head continuous, smooth, fully opaque bright white, bounded by its existing cyan neon outline. Remove the accidental transparent holes, dark blotches and distressed scratches inside the arrow. Keep the doorway opening transparent around the arrow, no new background. No text or numbers. Return one clean square PNG sprite.
